orchestrator_final_guard.required_pre_final_check: Before any final response, read loop-state: if stop_reason is empty and next_atomic_action is non-empty, dispatch or execute the next loop instead of stopping.
orchestrator_final_guard.remediation: Truth sources record the guard; orchestrator must treat this as a hard gate for all future loop turns.
